title: Quality Assurance Officer
overview: Own inline and end-line quality systems for branded apparel programs running through our Faisalabad facility.
You will work with production, merchandising, and compliance so audit-ready standards hold from cutting through packing — not only on inspection day.
requirements: Experience in garment quality assurance, preferably with export programs.
Working knowledge of AQL sampling, inline audits, and buyer quality manuals.
Clear written English for reports shared with merchandising and customers.
Comfort on the production floor as well as in documentation.

title: Production Supervisor
overview: Lead sewing-line output, line balancing, and shift discipline on cut-and-sew programs.
The role sits between planning and the floor: targets, attendance, quality feedback, and calm problem-solving when a line falls behind.
requirements: Supervisory experience in woven or knit garment production.
Ability to read a loading plan and translate it into hourly line targets.
Urdu and English sufficient for floor communication and written reports.
Willingness to work rotational shifts during peak seasons.

title: Sustainability Intern
overview: Support environmental reporting, data collection, and buyer-facing documentation across water, energy, and waste programs.
This is a structured internship with a defined last date — you will leave with a portfolio of real factory metrics, not a desk assignment.
requirements: Degree in progress or recently completed in environmental science, industrial engineering, or a related field.
Comfort with spreadsheets and careful handling of operational data.
Interest in apparel manufacturing and third-party certifications.

title: Merchandiser
overview: Run buyer programs from tech pack through shipment: T&A, sampling, costing coordination, and status that a sourcing team can trust.
You will sit with production and quality so delivery dates are operational facts, not optimistic slides.
requirements: Apparel merchandising experience with export customers.
Strong follow-up, calendar discipline, and written English.
Familiarity with sampling, consumption, and pre-production meetings.

title: Sewing Line Supervisor
overview: Take ownership of a sewing line’s efficiency, quality feedback, and operator support on branded programs.
This is a floor-first role for someone who can hold a standard without turning the line into a lecture.
requirements: Hands-on sewing-line leadership in knits or wovens.
Understanding of SMV, balancing, and common construction faults.
Respectful supervision and a record of meeting daily output with acceptable quality.
